{{Quote|I loved my father, but I was not going to ''die'' with him for no gain. There are limits to duty.|Rodas Borgin|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
A '''male Human''' served as [[Count/Legends|Count]] and Head of the [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Count was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by his own son, [[Rodas Borgin]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] drove the scions of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to [[Cleansing of Serenno|murder]] their [[Parent/Legends|fathers]] and take their place.<ref name="AOTE2" />
